bug_semantics: Netty's HAProxy PROXY protocol v2 decoder recursively parses nested PP2_TYPE_SSL TLVs, each as a retainedSlice of the channel cumulation buffer. readTlvs() flattens only the immediate children of top-level SSL TLVs into HAProxyMessage.tlvs(); depth-2+ encapsulated TLVs stay solely on HAProxySSLTLV.encapsulatedTLVs(). HAProxySSLTLV does not override deallocate, and HAProxyMessage.deallocate() only walks the flattened list, so a syntactically valid nested-SSL header parses, fires downstream, and is released by the application while the depth-2+ slices permanently pin the pooled ByteBuf (CWE-401).
flaw_origin: The incomplete ownership model was first written in 1f0d47dee797df8d437b4151aaa39fcfae73b513 (2016-09-28 author date; landed 2017-06-07): HAProxyMessage.readNextTLV() retained nested SSL/leaf TLV slices and readTlvs() addAll'd only one encapsulation level. Parent b03b0f22d1e54733c2d39c7f913f971dab14ebfa has HAProxyMessage but no TLV types, no readNextTLV/readTlvs, and no retainedSlice in codec-haproxy. Later 712077cdef050bc9aa211d301a1bdc3e763b6097 (#9250) added deallocate() over that same flattened list (incomplete general leak fix); cd91cf3c99123bd1e53fd6a1de0e3d1922f05bb2 (CVE-2022-41881) only capped recursion. Neither rewrote the flatten/retain mechanism.

reasoning: CVE-2026-48059 is a real, unwithdrawn HAProxy v2 nested-SSL TLV refcount leak. Decode of a valid nested PP2_TYPE_SSL header retains a slice per TLV; only depth-0 SSL plus its depth-1 children are placed in HAProxyMessage.tlvs(), so deallocate/release of the message never drops depth-2+ retains and the pooled cumulation stays pinned. The smallest public first-write of that retain-plus-one-level-flatten is 1f0d47dee797df8d437b4151aaa39fcfae73b513 (Added PROXY Protocol TLV support). Its parent lacks those lines/files. #9250's deallocate is a later incomplete remediation that walks the already-incomplete flatten list; the 2022 nesting-limit advisory only stopped stack overflow. BIC precedes 4.1.12+ and 4.2.0+ affected tags; the recursive-release fix lands at #16881 on 4.1 (bd6214fe, 4.1.135.Final) and the fork merge on 4.2 (270800e5, 4.2.15.Final).
